front.title: Periodic On-path Explicit Measurement of Delay

abstract.t: This document defines POEM Delay, a delay measurement companion to the Periodic On-path Explicit Measurement (POEM) protocol for QUIC. A delay sample packet, coalesced with ordinary QUIC packets, bounces between the endpoints. On-path observers timestamp it in each direction to measure the round-trip time and its components on either side of the observer. Each sample carries a coarse indication of how long the sending endpoint held it, so observers can largely exclude endpoint delay. A report packet lets observers tell endpoints how network delay is split between the two sides of the observer.
